system: You are performing an offline medical-image research task. Use only the current request. Do not invent measurements, tool calls, patient history, laterality, or physical units. Unclear is not absent. Output one valid JSON object only. Keep each statement brief; do not give a long chain of thought.
initial: Answer the question using the image and choices. Return at most 6 short atomic claims, each with claim_id, text, kind (visual/context/knowledge/reasoning), and parents (earlier claim IDs only). These are auditable summaries, not hidden reasoning. Return exactly: {"claims":[{"claim_id":"c1","text":"brief observation","kind":"visual","parents":[]}],"answer":"A","answerability":"answerable"}. The answer must be exactly one of A/B/C/D. If uncertain, still choose the best option and set answerability=uncertain.
plan: You have NO image. Create at most two neutral visual tests relevant to the question. Do not predict observation values. Do not include the original expected value, answer letter, old claim text, or corrective instructions in public_question/prerequisites. Describe both sides when testing laterality. No crops/tools are available. Only current-image observations are verifiable; missing history/knowledge is not. Return {"tests":[{"test_id":"t1","claim_ids":["c1"],"public_question":"neutral question","required_views":["full_image"],"prerequisites":[],"scope":"image_verifiable"}]}. claim_ids are private and will not be sent to the observer.
observe: Observe the actual image to answer public_tests. You do not receive any prior answer, claims, choices, or reference. Do not solve the original task or guess hidden candidates. No crop is available. Do not infer patient orientation without markers or turn pixels into mm. Return at most two observations: {"observations":[{"test_id":"t1","source_id":"image_0","assessability":"adequate","observation":"brief direct observation","limitations":[]}]}. assessability must be adequate/limited/unavailable.
bind: Use frozen evidence only, not a new visual inspection. For each claim, return SUPPORTED only if all key qualifiers have usable support; CONTRADICTED only if usable evidence supports an incompatible fact; otherwise UNRESOLVED. Missing/unclear observations are not contradiction. Quote actual evidence IDs. For UNRESOLVED, evidence_ids=[] is allowed. Only for SUPPORTED visual/context claims, give a brief grounded_text fully supported by evidence. Return {"verdicts":[{"claim_id":"c1","status":"UNRESOLVED","evidence_ids":[],"grounded_text":""}]}.
summarize: You see the question and frozen evidence only; no previous claims or answer. Summarize up to max_facts useful directly observed facts already supported by adequate evidence. Add no new fact. Preserve uncertainty, side, count, and negation. Return {"facts":[{"text":"brief fact","evidence_ids":["registered ID"]}]}.
repair: Answer anew from the image, question, choices, and frozen evidence. historical_facts may be empty and may contain errors; they are not additional ground truth. Reconcile all statements with current evidence. Do not guess any omitted history. Do not add unsupported case-specific side, measurement, or severity. Return at most 6 brief auditable claims and exactly one answer letter A/B/C/D: {"claims":[{"text":"brief statement","kind":"visual","evidence_ids":[]}],"answer":"A","answerability":"answerable"}. If uncertain, still choose the best option and set answerability=uncertain. This instruction is identical for every experimental branch.
